title: Thuringia, a generated test network
description: A roaming network of medium size, generated and signed with test keys: 7 charging station operators, 195 charging pools, 417 charging stations and 834 EVSEs across Thuringia; 25 commits with change sets of several owners, a key rotation, a removed pool, a latecomer; 4 checkpoints signed by two witnesses, price statements and station proofs.
